conventions.completion: actual played kickoff + 4h, strictly before original issuance (bounded by T75 for retrospective cards)
conventions.league: all completed current-season regular-season scores, independent of model version; no prior fallback
conventions.percentile: 100 * (count below + 0.5 * count equal) / n; no rounding before ranking
conventions.team_fallback: prior-season actual regular-season scores; explicitly flagged, no historical version inferred
